meta.name: Rock, Paper, Landmines
meta.description: Glico, Daruma-san ga Koronda... A game everyone knows—transformed into the ultimate battle of wits!?

videos.title: Rock, Paper, Landmines
videos.overview: Mato, urged on by Koda, competes in the Guen Game to win rooftop space for their food stall. The final match is "Rock, Paper, Landmines." Her opponent is Kunugi, an ace of the student council. Mato weaves a web of bold strategies. Then, Saburi, schemes something. Meanwhile, Mato and Koda run into trouble involving the karuta club.

videos.title: Bōzu Memory
videos.overview: The teacher recruits Koda for the dance club, but she declines. Mato is furious at the teacher's remark, "life is like a game." Just then, she learns about the trouble with the karuta club. Then, she takes on the café owner in a game, "Bōzu Memory" to get the Karuta Club's ban lifted. When Saburi mentions a certain person's name, memories of a past conflict resurface in Mato's mind.

videos.title: Freestyle Rock-Paper-Scissors
videos.overview: Esora calls the school of fish that they protect themselves; Mato says they only monitor each other. Esora sees her survival strategy. Saburi confronts Mato. At Esora's name Mato's face changes. She baits her with a match vs Esora into Freestyle Rock-Paper-Scissors. Saburi reveals Seietsu High's S-chips and dark games. Mato challenges the student council to gather S-chips.

videos.title: Red Light, Green Light, One, Two, Three
videos.overview: The stage for the S-chip battle "experimental learning" vs Seietsu High is a park. Opponents: gaming geek Sudo and Okegawa with exceptional hearing. The game is "Red Light, Green Light, One, Two, Three." Mato adds a rule multiplying stakes by 10. Afterwards Esora takes Niizuma's call, sees through everything, and happily accepts the challenge against Mato.

videos.title: Four Room Poker (1)
videos.overview: The three finally reunite. Mato and Esora face off in the final game "Four Room Poker." It is a psych battle of logic, memory, and reading each other's thoughts. Esora seems to see through Mato's strategy. Anxiety spreads among the Hoojiro members, Koda's doubts waver, and friendship itself is tested. Will Mato's plan work? As the game progresses, a shocking development strikes them…

videos.title: Four Room Poker (2)
videos.overview: The game continues even amid emergencies. Saved by Koda, Mato enters the final round and appears so calm. The two draw enormous amounts of S-chips from each other. Cornered by Esora's schemes, Mato is pushed to the brink. The exchanges between them who know each other completely produce an astonishing result. In time their past is revealed. What was Mato's true aim through challenging these games?
